slides.claim: PMO-level written authority delegating IOCL Chairman procurement approval above ₹5,000 crore without case-by-case MoF concurrence—with explicit Prevention of Corruption Act coverage to remove behavioral paralysis—is a prerequisite for every other sourcing decision to execute; without it, the War Room is a coordination structure with no decision velocity.

containment_playbook.content: IOCL Chairman approved to execute crude procurement contracts up to ₹15,000 crore per transaction without MoF case-by-case concurrence
containment_playbook.why_PMO_not_MoPNG: Only PMO-level written authority provides behavioral cover under PC Act — Secretary-level directive insufficient for criminal liability shield; COVID-19 precedent confirms PMO as correct issuing authority

containment_playbook.content: Written indemnification language in PMO authority letter explicitly covering procurement decisions made under emergency delegation
containment_playbook.precedent: COVID-19 Empowered Groups notification (PIB March 2020) — PMO constituted empowered group with bypass authority for standard procurement concurrence within 48 hours; HIGH confidence on institutional template

containment_playbook.content: MoF Secretary to issue standing LC authorization to SBI and BoB for IOCL obligations up to ₹60,000 crore for 30 days
containment_playbook.why_required: Removes SBI/BoB behavioral hesitancy on over-limit LC issuance (separate from RBI formal dispensation); SBI Chairman will not exceed sanctioned limits without MoF written backstop even if informal phone assurance given

containment_playbook.content: Emergency dispensation for PSU bank crude LC issuance above current sectoral exposure limits
containment_playbook.caveat: No confirmed precedent for formal RBI sectoral dispensation specifically for crude oil LCs in prior episodes — informal bank accommodation has been the historical norm (2008, 2012, 2022); formal dispensation provides legal certainty that informal accommodation does not

containment_playbook.content: Board resolution expanding IOCL Chairman transaction authority above current Articles of Association limits — required because MoPNG Secretary directive cannot override IOCL's own AoA
containment_playbook.deadline: Emergency Board meeting by April 4 (48-hour notice requirement); must run in parallel with PMO authority letter
containment_playbook.note: This is a 24–48 hour procedural step the one-pager does not explicitly name but is required for PMO authority to be legally operative

proof_content.sequencing: All three instruments (PMO written authority + MoF LC backstop + RBI dispensation) must be in writing before any procurement or banking action can execute — verbal assurance is insufficient because it does not remove PC Act liability or SBI over-limit hesitancy. The War Room constituted without these instruments is a coordination structure that produces decisions no one will sign.
